interpretation: Rank32 is a coordinate-budget baseline, not equal model-class/parameter capacity to conditional32-of128. Rank128 compares global linear spaces at dense LS rank. PCA fits local training variance, so better reconstruction need not improve native response. This separates linear dimension from conditional supports; no manifold/semantic-unit claim by itself.
stop: One fixed two-rank comparison. Then make a concrete decision about linear subspaces versus conditional feature groups and the next validation of computational structure. No further rank/loss sweep on the development panel. Whole-task training exclusions persist.
